logp.method_description: The ruthenium complexes (Ru-1, Ru-2, Ru-3, and Ru-4) were diluted to 25 μg/mL with n-octanol. Part of the ruthenium complex solution was mixed with an equal volume of water and then shaken for 6 h. The mixture stained overnight. The characteristic UV absorbance values of ruthenium complexes were recorded using a UV spectrophotometer. The change in absorbance values in the grease phase and the aqueous phase was observed.
